name: One MA EA
summary: This EA trades based on a single Moving Average indicator, opening buy positions when price crosses above the MA and sell positions when price crosses below. It uses the MA as a dynamic trend filter and signal generator, with configurable period, method, and applied price. The EA is a straightforward trend-following system that relies on MA crossovers for entry and typically uses opposite signals or fixed take-profit/stop-loss for exits.
summary_zh: 该EA基于单一移动平均线指标进行交易，当价格上穿MA时开多单，下穿时开空单。它将MA作为动态趋势过滤器和信号生成器，可配置周期、方法和应用价格。这是一个简单直接的趋势跟踪系统，依赖MA交叉作为入场信号，通常使用反向信号或固定止盈止损出场。
strategy_analysis: 该EA采用单一移动平均线作为趋势判断的核心指标，策略概念非常简洁——价格位于MA之上视为上升趋势做多，价格位于MA之下视为下降趋势做空。入场条件通常为价格与MA的交叉：收盘价上穿MA时开多仓，收盘价下穿MA时开空仓。出场条件可能包括反向交叉信号平仓、固定止盈止损，或者两者结合使用。仓位管理方面，该EA通常使用固定手数交易，缺乏基于波动率或账户风险的动态仓位调整机制。资金管理较为基础，可能仅依赖止损来控制单笔亏损，没有额外的资金管理规则如最大回撤限制或连续亏损后的仓位缩减。整体策略逻辑清晰但较为单一，在震荡行情中容易产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA uses a single Moving Average as the core indicator for trend determination, with a straightforward strategy concept—price above the MA is considered an uptrend for buying, and price below the MA is considered a downtrend for selling. Entry conditions are typically based on price-MA crossovers: a buy position is opened when the close price crosses above the MA, and a sell position when it crosses below. Exit conditions may include closing on opposite crossover signals, fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels, or a combination of both. Position sizing is typically handled with fixed lots, lacking dynamic sizing based on volatility or account risk percentage. Money management is relatively basic, likely relying only on stop-loss to control per-trade loss without additional rules such as maximum drawdown limits or position reduction after consecutive losses. The overall strategy logic is clear but simplistic, making it prone to frequent false signals and consecutive losses during choppy or ranging market conditions.

pros: 策略逻辑简单清晰，易于理解和调试
单一指标减少了参数过拟合的风险
趋势行情中能够有效捕捉中长期趋势
代码结构简洁，适合作为学习MQL5的入门EA
可配置参数较多，适应不同交易品种和时间周期
pros_en: Simple and clear strategy logic, easy to understand and debug
Single indicator reduces the risk of parameter overfitting
Effectively captures medium-to-long-term trends in trending markets
Clean code structure, suitable as a beginner EA for learning MQL5
Multiple configurable parameters for adaptation to different instruments and timeframes
cons: 单一MA信号滞后严重，入场时机偏晚
震荡行情中频繁产生虚假信号导致连续亏损
缺乏动态仓位管理，无法根据市场波动调整风险敞口
没有防重复开仓机制和新K线检测，可能同一信号重复下单
缺少点差过滤和交易时段过滤，滑点成本可能较高
cons_en: Single MA signal has significant lag, resulting in late entries
Frequent false signals during ranging/choppy markets lead to consecutive losses
Lacks dynamic position sizing, unable to adjust risk exposure based on market volatility
May lack duplicate order prevention and new bar detection, potentially opening multiple orders on the same signal
No spread filter or trading session filter, slippage costs may be high
improvements: 增加第二MA或ADX作为趋势强度过滤器，减少震荡市中的虚假信号
实现基于ATR的动态止损止盈和仓位管理，提高风险调整后收益
添加新K线检测和信号去重机制，避免同一信号重复开仓
增加点差过滤和交易时段限制，降低不利交易环境下的成本
加入移动止损(Trailing Stop)功能，保护已有浮盈
improvements_en: Add a second MA or ADX as trend strength filter to reduce false signals in ranging markets
Implement ATR-based dynamic stop-loss, take-profit and position sizing for better risk-adjusted returns
Add new bar detection and signal deduplication to prevent duplicate orders on the same signal
Add spread filter and trading session restrictions to reduce costs in unfavorable trading conditions
Add trailing stop functionality to protect floating profits

risk_points: 缺少新K线检测可能在同一根K线内重复开仓
固定手数未根据账户资金和波动率动态调整
单MA策略在震荡市中容易连续止损
止损设置可能不足或为零导致风险敞口无限
risk_points_en: Lack of new bar detection may cause duplicate order opening within the same bar
Fixed lot size not dynamically adjusted based on account equity and volatility
Single MA strategy prone to consecutive stop-losses in ranging markets
Stop-loss may be insufficient or zero, leading to unlimited risk exposure
